evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 7.9 ppm at the end of the ramp.
Growth began with oxygen 8.9 ppm and pressure 2.998 Torr.
Oxygen rose to 18.2 ppm and pressure to 3.135 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Oxygen increased further to 24.3 ppm and pressure to 3.212 Torr while temperature held at 750.0 C and argon at 99.9 sccm; the sustained atmosphere drift is not explained by setpoint changes.

args.missing_evidence: Normal growth-stage oxygen and pressure tolerances and a leak-integrity/exhaust-conductance check are needed to distinguish air ingress, exhaust restriction, or another source of atmosphere drift. No sample characterization is available.
